financial_package.note: Pay Level S-20 under Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019 for Group A State Civil Services posts (Deputy Collector, DSP/ACP, Assistant Commissioner of State Tax).
financial_package.pay_source_label: Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019, Government Resolution No. RPS-2019/CR-1/Services-9
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹56,100 in Level S-20 (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500). Gross range computed with 58% DA (₹32,538) plus HRA (9% to 27% depending on district/metro posting city), executive transport allowance, minus 10% NPS and state insurance deductions.
official_perks: Government accommodation (designated Sub-Divisional Magistrate / Collectorate residential quarters)
Official staff vehicle with driver for official duty travel
Executive staff support (Peon / Orderly, Steno, Revenue Assistant)
Comprehensive medical coverage under Maharashtra State Government Employees Health Scheme
Subsidized electricity, water, and residential broadband/telephone facility
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and defined annual leave benefits
